public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Impulse Labs is a Series A climate and energy technology company founded by Sam D'Amico that has raised $25M to date. The valuation exercise draws on a comp universe of nine peers in the Climate & Energy sector, including one public company (LNZA) and eight private firms such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using total raised ($25M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Series A-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.0x yields an implied valuation of $50M. A peer-median approach could not be applied due to insufficient narrow-stage peer datapoints; while eight same-sector peers exist, none qualified as same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables under the filtering criteria, and a broad sector median would lack precision.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $42M to $57M, with a median of $50M. This range reflects the 15% cushion typical in single-method triangulation. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.0x multiplier for Impulse's specific subsector and business profile, the absence of high-fidelity peer benchmarks at identical stage and scale, and limited visibility into recent rounds among the comp set. Any material differences in Impulse's technology maturity, capital efficiency, or market timing relative to peers would warrant adjustment within the stated band.
